scope: finite agreed-scope operation closure; extend for actual game needs

operations.name: Primary-source research
operations.candidate_methods: Web research, official documentation and papers, and authorized connected sources
operations.output_acceptance: Fact and inference ledger with freshness, access and support for the specific claim

operations.name: Intent and decisions
operations.candidate_methods: Director/Foundry, versioned Markdown/JSON, hashes
operations.output_acceptance: Trace source to requirement, decision and scope. Record current authority and handoff.

operations.name: System model
operations.candidate_methods: Typed data, statecharts, decision/interaction graphs
operations.output_acceptance: Complete rules and catalogs, stable IDs, and C1/TDD receiver review

operations.name: Mathematics and simulation
operations.candidate_methods: Pure functions and Python/Fractions. Use NumPy or Hypothesis as needed.
operations.output_acceptance: Numerical oracles, distributions, units, sensitivity and scoped evidence

operations.name: Concept frame
operations.candidate_methods: Available raster image generation or another verified provider route
operations.output_acceptance: Accepted target and profile, exact original, feasibility and lineage

operations.name: Art direction and vector assets
operations.candidate_methods: Krita, Inkscape and project-owned style tokens
operations.output_acceptance: Editable source, silhouette, materials, camera, typography and rights

operations.name: Sprite/cutout
operations.candidate_methods: Krita, supported generation or editing, and alpha inspection
operations.output_acceptance: Consistent layers, poses, pivot and scale, and verified transparency

operations.name: Atlas and frames
operations.candidate_methods: DCC/export scripts, engine import
operations.output_acceptance: Frame metadata, padding/bleed, filtering, packing, pixel parity

operations.name: 2D motion
operations.candidate_methods: Keyframes, cutouts or skeletal motion using Krita, Blender or Godot according to asset type
operations.output_acceptance: Clips, transitions and markers, foot and other contacts, cancellation and readability

operations.name: 3D geometry
operations.candidate_methods: Blender or a verified image or multiview to 3D route
operations.output_acceptance: Source mesh, scale, axes, topology, and visible and hidden surfaces

operations.name: Retopology/LOD
operations.candidate_methods: Blender/manual/procedural cleanup
operations.output_acceptance: Deformation topology, silhouette, triangles/LOD/collision budgets

operations.name: UV/PBR/materials
operations.candidate_methods: Blender/Krita, bake/import presets
operations.output_acceptance: UV/texel density/maps/color space, platform material parity

operations.name: Rig/skin
operations.candidate_methods: Blender or a verified rigging adapter
operations.output_acceptance: Skeleton, bind pose, weights and rest pose, with deformation and attachment tests

operations.name: 3D clips/retarget
operations.candidate_methods: Blender or Godot, and authorized library, motion-capture or procedural inputs
operations.output_acceptance: Root/in-place policy, retarget, contacts, clips/markers/cleanup

operations.name: Collision and physics profiles
operations.candidate_methods: Godot/backend authoring/query fixtures
operations.output_acceptance: Hit, hurt and part geometry, units, layers, CCD and resolver compatibility

operations.name: VFX/shader/light
operations.candidate_methods: Godot particles/shaders/lighting, DCC bake
operations.output_acceptance: Event-bound effects, low-tier/reduced-effects/cue collision checks

operations.name: UI, fonts, and localization
operations.candidate_methods: Godot Control and Theme, vector assets and licensed fonts
operations.output_acceptance: Stateful UI, string IDs, glyph/plural/layout/input coverage

operations.name: Music composition
operations.candidate_methods: Composer and DAW, such as LMMS or Ardour. Use AI where the scope and rights permit.
operations.output_acceptance: Motifs, structure and tempo, editable session, MIDI or stems where required

operations.name: SFX
operations.candidate_methods: Recording, synthesis and licensed libraries, with Audacity or a DAW
operations.output_acceptance: Raw or editable sources, material and action families, variants and rights

operations.name: Voice
operations.candidate_methods: Recording or a verified TTS provider
operations.output_acceptance: Locked transcript, pronunciation/locale/voice approval, source/rights

operations.name: Audio editing/export
operations.candidate_methods: Audacity, DAW or FFmpeg, measurements and listening
operations.output_acceptance: Loops and regions, noise, clicks and clipping, format, channels and memory. Set context-specific LUFS limits.

operations.name: Runtime audio/music
operations.candidate_methods: Godot buses, Randomizer or Interactive. Use FMOD or Wwise where justified.
operations.output_acceptance: Event/parameter/mix/ducking/transition/voice limits, device listening

operations.name: Haptics
operations.candidate_methods: Engine or platform vibration and Core Haptics where supported
operations.output_acceptance: Semantic patterns, limits and cancellation, and mute and haptic-free equivalents

operations.name: Gameplay code
operations.candidate_methods: Godot with typed GDScript, or languages appropriate to the engine and profile
operations.output_acceptance: Rule, state and component modules, explicit ownership and runtime parity

operations.name: AI/world/narrative authoring
operations.candidate_methods: State machines, BT, utility selection, planning or grammar according to the task
operations.output_acceptance: Behavior, encounters and graphs with traces, legality and budgets

operations.name: Local data and saves
operations.candidate_methods: Typed resources or JSON, and SQLite when needed
operations.output_acceptance: Schema/transactions/generations, exact types, migrations/recovery

operations.name: Cloud continuation
operations.candidate_methods: Google/Apple adapters, D1 policies
operations.output_acceptance: Profile binding, conflict/restore/account/quota native proofs

operations.name: Backend, data, and deployment where needed
operations.candidate_methods: Suitable language and API with PostgreSQL, Docker, Render, Supabase or another selected system
operations.output_acceptance: Authority, data, API and schema, authorization, migration, deployment, recovery and explicit costs

operations.name: Native SDK adapters
operations.candidate_methods: Android Java/Kotlin/JNI; Apple Swift/ObjC/native bridge
operations.output_acceptance: Callback/thread/lifecycle/ABI/capability contracts, release probes

operations.name: Code quality
operations.candidate_methods: Engine conventions, static typing, formatter, linter and review for the selected language
operations.output_acceptance: Clear interfaces, warnings and boundaries. Add frameworks only when their behavior is needed.

operations.name: Logic/model/property tests
operations.candidate_methods: GUT or GdUnit4 when compatible, and pytest or Hypothesis for reference tools
operations.output_acceptance: Golden, negative and property cases with independent expectations

operations.name: Engine integration
operations.candidate_methods: Test scenes and a headless runner where suitable
operations.output_acceptance: Input to rules, actors, resources and saves through actual bindings, with verified event order

operations.name: Native/device/human
operations.candidate_methods: adb and Android tools, Xcode and XCTest where suitable, and physical-device sessions
operations.output_acceptance: Multitouch, lifecycle, accessibility and comfort on a phone. Record headless checks separately.

operations.name: Perceptual acceptance
operations.candidate_methods: Actual captures/listening/side-by-side, bounded diff metrics
operations.output_acceptance: Reference fidelity, motion and contact, audio and haptics in the integrated scene

operations.name: Performance
operations.candidate_methods: Godot profiler, Android Perfetto or AGI, or Apple Instruments by target
operations.output_acceptance: Cold and peak performance, thermal, frame, input, memory and power traces with the method

operations.name: Source/provenance
operations.candidate_methods: Git with LFS where needed, lockfiles and hashes, and attestations
operations.output_acceptance: Exact source/assets/toolchain→artifact, trusted provenance boundaries

operations.name: Android build/sign
operations.candidate_methods: Godot export with compatible JDK, Gradle, SDK and templates
operations.output_acceptance: Verified AAB and APK, signing, configuration and ABIs, and installation and launch receipts

operations.name: Apple build/sign
operations.candidate_methods: Mac/Xcode/export/provisioning/codesign
operations.output_acceptance: Exact archive or IPA, capabilities, native run and symbols

operations.name: CI/artifact delivery
operations.candidate_methods: Local runners, GitHub Actions or another selected CI system
operations.output_acceptance: Staged jobs, input-pinned caches, immutable outputs, secrets boundaries

operations.name: Commerce/ad sandbox
operations.candidate_methods: StoreKit, Play Billing and rewarded SDK where in scope
operations.output_acceptance: Buy/pending/cancel/refund/restore/no-fill, grant once/reconcile

operations.name: Store distribution
operations.candidate_methods: Play tracks/TestFlight/App Store workflows
operations.output_acceptance: Exact candidate, metadata, rights and tester prerequisites, staged release and actual receipts

operations.name: Observability/support
operations.candidate_methods: Logs, reason codes, symbols and reproduction, with selected analytics or crash tools as needed
operations.output_acceptance: Health and incident diagnosis, safe diagnostics and verified repair and recovery. Prove any running monitoring separately.

operations.name: Live operations and updates
operations.candidate_methods: Versioned config/content/schema, compatibility/rollout/runbooks
operations.output_acceptance: Impact, recovery/forward fix, economy/context, rights/service-loss policy

operations.name: Distribution and acquisition where in scope
operations.candidate_methods: Product hypotheses, ASO and store assets, accurate native footage and authorized channels
operations.output_acceptance: Understandable product value, original authorship, rights, attribution and observed outcomes

operations.name: Agent update
operations.candidate_methods: Skill Creator/Foundry, canonical Git source, package/update/verify/rollback
operations.output_acceptance: Consistent 9 skills and resources, portable Work and Codex instructions, and actual proof of the loaded version

mechanisms.mechanism: Operation-level evidence of production capability, beyond the native SDK probe D1Q19
mechanisms.negative_acceptance: Verify required editable layers or a rig independently of a flattened PNG.

mechanisms.mechanism: Executable recipe and consumer, extending authoring round-trip Q27
mechanisms.negative_acceptance: A new receiver can find the preset, source and exports and verify the result without chat history.

mechanisms.mechanism: Semantic invariants at each transfer, extending post-import lint Q26
mechanisms.negative_acceptance: Reject a format-valid mesh or clip if scale or contact timing changes.

mechanisms.mechanism: Coverage of all required production outputs, beyond sample throughput Q36
mechanisms.negative_acceptance: Every required death, cancel, locale and contact state has a feasible route.

mechanisms.mechanism: Actual production attempt history, separate from gameplay reproduction Q28
mechanisms.negative_acceptance: After timeout, reconcile actual paid generation or remote build before retrying.

mechanisms.mechanism: Admission based on accepted inputs, interfaces, resources, and required expertise
mechanisms.negative_acceptance: Concurrent writers and shared exporters or devices preserve output integrity.

mechanisms.mechanism: Cache identity includes semantic inputs and evidence freshness
mechanisms.negative_acceptance: Exporter and model changes invalidate affected outputs and preserve accepted originals.

mechanisms.mechanism: Integrated acceptance criteria for the representative slice
mechanisms.negative_acceptance: Verify contact in the assembled scene independently of standalone motion and audio reviews.
Route missing rig capability explicitly instead of repeating the same prompt five times.

mechanisms.mechanism: Host handoff with pinned inputs and validated return
mechanisms.negative_acceptance: Reestablish current iOS proof independently of an older Android receipt.

mechanisms.mechanism: Descriptor, schema, catalog and argument binding with verified parameter consumption
mechanisms.negative_acceptance: Keep requirements open when a material parameter is unsupported or ignored.
